PRESSURE INDEX

Multi-Factor Formulation

Indexes required run rate, wicket leverage, and phase into continuous scale \(PI \in [0, 100]\). 78,374 deliveries categorized under High Pressure (39.0%).

WPA LOGISTIC

Chase Modeling (AUC 0.897)

Trained on 95,272 chase balls. First-innings evaluated via crisis collapse (≤30/3) and death par benchmarks. WPA rates use chase balls as denominator.

SHRINKAGE

Bayesian Prior & Quality

Shrinkage ($k=80$) prevents small-sample distortion. Tournament quality weighting (IPL 1.00×, T20I 0.90×, Associate 0.75×).
